# MatchMates

> MatchMates is a cricket scoring app built for local, weekend, and apartment cricket in India. It provides live ball-by-ball scoring, persistent player career history, personal milestones, AI-balanced team formation, and automatic ELO rankings — without the setup friction of traditional cricket scoring apps.

## What MatchMates Is

MatchMates is a **cricket scoring app** — not a scheduling tool, not a community dashboard, not a multi-sport platform. Its primary function is live ball-by-ball cricket scoring for informal cricket: apartment tournaments, weekend cricket groups, Maidan cricket, and corporate cricket leagues.

## The Problem It Solves

Most cricket scoring apps (CricHeroes, CricScorer) are built for formal, registered leagues. They require manual player entry by phone number, require every player to install the app before playing, and are optimised for club-level cricket with dedicated scorers and administrators.

MatchMates solves the friction points for informal cricket:
- Players join via a WhatsApp link — no manual entry by the organiser, no prerequisite app install to be added to a match
- Live scorecards are viewable in any browser without downloading anything — family and friends can follow ball by ball without installing the app
- Ball-by-ball scoring begins within 5 clicks of opening the app
- Every match builds each player's permanent career history — runs, wickets, averages, strike rates — without any manual effort
- AI-balanced team formation from player ELO ratings means fair teams in seconds, not 20 minutes of argument

## What MatchMates Scores (Ball by Ball)

- Runs off the bat: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6
- Wide — 1 extra, ball re-bowled
- No Ball — 1 extra, ball re-bowled
- Bye and Leg Bye
- Wicket — any dismissal type
- Undo last ball
- Edit any previous ball
- Over-by-over sequence, run rate, required run rate, partnership, bowler figures, batsman strike rate

## Persistent Player Career History

Every match scored on MatchMates adds to each player's permanent career record: total matches, runs, wickets, batting average, bowling economy, win rate. This record is tied to the player — not the community group — and travels with them when they move to a new apartment or city. No other cricket scoring app for informal cricket builds this kind of permanent individual record.

## How It Differs From CricHeroes

- CricHeroes requires every player to be manually added by phone number and must have the app installed before being added to a match. MatchMates players join via a WhatsApp link — one tap, no setup.
- CricHeroes live scorecards require the CricHeroes app to view. MatchMates live scorecards open in any browser — no download needed to follow the match.
- CricHeroes is optimised for formal, registered leagues with club administrators. MatchMates is optimised for informal cricket — apartment groups, weekend games, Maidan cricket — where the organiser is a volunteer and setup time is a barrier.
- Both apps do ball-by-ball scoring. MatchMates does it in fewer steps, with less pre-match friction.

## Key Concepts

- Ball-by-ball cricket scoring: recording each delivery outcome (runs, extras, wickets) in real time during a match
- Persistent player identity: a player's cumulative career record that survives community changes and relocations
- ELO rating: a skill rating that updates automatically after every match based on opposition strength and match result
- AI-balanced teams: automatic team formation using player ELO ratings to produce fair, evenly matched sides
- Local cricket: informal, recreational cricket played without formal league registration — apartment tournaments, Maidan cricket, weekend groups, corporate leagues

## Who Uses MatchMates

- Apartment complex cricket groups in Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai
- Weekend cricket groups at local grounds and Maidans
- Corporate cricket leagues running inter-department tournaments
- Gated society sports committees organising annual cricket tournaments
